name: dataset v2 (look freeze): training clips at the look-freeze commit
status: rendering at aea01f4 on the maintainer's Mac (Oct 21)
commit: aea01f4e5d168b0ff3e8e44143cd4baaaf9a3f60: main after #197 (renderer 0.5.9), main's CI green, given by the Coordinator and recorded here before the first render. #179 is excluded, Kian's decision: the football it changes does not affect the detector. The earlier pending condition (after #179, #183 and motion A) is replaced by this decision; #183 and motion A (#197) are in it. A dry run at #188's merge commit measured speed only; none of its clips joins the dataset
why: Every training clip in one look and one engine, the look the demo shows. Dataset v1 mixed capsule players (0.3.x) with later mesh clips; the round 2 plan (docs/eval/round2/PLAN.md) needs one render commit for everything.

seeds.rule: the seed list and overrides of v3 (docs/eval/dataset-v1.json), so the two datasets differ only in engine and look

groups.note: hard cases drawn from the seed at HARD_CASE_RATE 0.3 (#87)

seeds.excluded_in_advance: none: v1 dropped 82 and 111 for defects of its own engine and renderer; here a seed is excluded only by the checks below
seeds.test_seeds: none in the training list; the frozen test set is a separate split (test_set below)

render.window: the seed's own start (render_clip's default), as v3
render.gl: the pod's GPU (infra/pod/render.py --gl gpu: Chromium on the NVIDIA driver through ANGLE, Vulkan or EGL), used only if WebGL reports the GPU, never SwiftShader or llvmpipe, and two renders of the same 10 s clip are byte-identical on the pod; otherwise software GL (SwiftShader) on the same pod, as the Azure job. Pixels are reproducible on this pod; identity with another machine is not required, since every clip renders here. Each clip's clip.json records gl, and each result line the WebGL renderer string
render.params: everything else drawn from the seed; only the overrides above are set

checks.per_clip: ninety.render.checks.check_clip: ball and keypoint projection under 1 px, every player's feet in his box, labels complete, and ninety-validate (the data contract)
checks.rule: a clip that fails any check is excluded and listed with its report; it is not re-rendered (same seed, same result) and no other seed replaces it
checks.determinism: seed 3 rendered twice on the pod, each in a fresh browser, with the GL the run uses: frames.jsonl, events.jsonl and every image byte-identical (infra/pod/render.py determinism), before the first dataset clip; and seeds 3 and 2001 again after the run
checks.floors: ninety-data-stats --floors on the passing clips, reported, not used to choose clips

machine: a rented Runpod GPU pod (RTX 4090 class, PyTorch template, 100 GB), deleted after the run and then reused for the detector fine-tune; all 310 clips render on this one pod. Kian's choice over the Mac, which started the test set with software GL at 1 worker (about 20 clips an hour) and is stopped once the pod run is confirmed; its clips are not used, since they are software GL and the pod's are not. Only synthetic renders go to the pod (AGENTS.md, vision models)
storage: train: renders/<run>/train/seed<N>/ (images, clip.json, meta.json) and truth/<run>/train/seed<N>/ (frames.jsonl, events.jsonl), as ninety/render/job.py uploads; test: truth-test instead of truth; the manifest at renders/<run>/manifest.json
manifest: every file of every passing clip, both splits, with its sha256 and size, the clip's drawn parameters, and the commits of the render and of the driver (infra/pod/render.py)

test_set.why: train and test share the look; round 2 (docs/eval/round2/PLAN.md) needs its 30-clip test set at the one render commit
test_set.status: rendered only: never inspected or tuned on, scored only by the frozen step-D protocol
test_set.render: the seed's own parameters, no overrides (the test split refuses them), 10 s, software GL, no dead-ball cut
test_set.checks: the same per-clip checks; a failing test clip is listed, never replaced
test_set.storage: renders/<run>/test/seed<N>/ (images, clip.json) and truth-test/<run>/test/seed<N>/ (frames.jsonl, events.jsonl, meta.json: the answer key, as the 91d1e3b test set), never the truth container
test_set.machine: rendered first, on the same pod and GL as the training clips; cross-machine identity is not required (every clip renders on the one pod)

upload: no credential goes to the render machine: the outputs are copied back over SSH, every sha256 checked against the manifest here, and uploaded from the maintainer's machine with its az login (infra/pod/render.py upload --account)
qa: before upload, infra/pod/qa.py: contact sheets (8 frames each) of 20 passing training clips drawn with random seed 20261021, fixed now, plus every training clip the checks flagged, for the Coordinator to look at; and a summary: excluded clips, render-check totals per split, the manifest verified. Test clips are never drawn or shown
